client_narrative: Miriam Kovacs is 74 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 28,000 euros (around 2,333 euros per month). They hold 250,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 40,000 euros with a 5-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has basic investment experience, limited to savings accounts, fixed-term deposits, and simple fixed-income products. Their investment approach is moderate — they rate their risk tolerance at 5 out of 10. They have confirmed they can afford to lose the entire 40,000 euros if the investment performs poorly. At 74 years of age, they are classified as financially vulnerable under MiFID II guidelines.
product_narrative: The product is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the MSCI World Index, providing diversified exposure to approximately 1,500 large and mid-cap equities across 23 developed markets. The fund is listed on major European exchanges, trades intraday with high liquidity, publishes a KID, contains no embedded derivatives, and uses no leverage. The recommended minimum investment horizon is five years.
